note: White County GA publishes its countywide zoning map only as a PDF (assessorsearch.com links the county zoning map PDF page). The City of Cleveland publishes its zoning map as a PDF (clevelandga.org/media/416), and the City of Helen links a zoning map with no queryable service. The county's qPublic (Schneider) viewer has a Zoning layer, but its service is not publicly queryable as ArcGIS REST and the page is blocked by a Cloudflare challenge. No White County or city ArcGIS REST zoning district layer was found in ArcGIS Hub, ArcGIS Online or web searches.
